Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Which group on the periodic table contains elements that are the least reactive?
A. group 1 (1A)
B. group 3 (3B)
C. group 16 (6A)
D. group 18 (8A)
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
